item.subject: maths
item.stem:
Chirag must divide the $16$ cm by $12$ cm rectangle in the diagram into identical squares that fill it with no gaps and no overlaps.

Which claim correctly plans the equal segments?

options.A: Mark equal $4$ cm segments along the $16$ cm and $12$ cm sides so squares of side $4$ cm fill the rectangle.
options.B: Mark segments of length $16$ cm only, and ignore making the $12$ cm side match equal square sides.
options.C: The rough diagram of the rectangle produces identical squares even when corresponding sides are unequal.
options.D: Square the side lengths $16$ and $12$ to decide the square size.
